articles.title: 'That's why he's the king' - Messi sets up third World Cup final
articles.summary: BBC Sport looks at Lionel Messi's masterclass on the right wing to knock England out of the World Cup.

articles.title: Argentina shatter England's World Cup dreams in semi-final
articles.summary: Argentina shatter England's World Cup dreams, scoring two late goals to come from behind and knock out Thomas Tuchel's side, in a dramatic semi-final in Atlanta.

articles.title: 'Gutted' - Kane disappointed over World Cup exit
articles.summary: England captain Harry Kane gives his analysis on their defeat against Argentina in the 2026 World Cup semi-final at Atlanta Stadium.

articles.title: Late Martinez header sends Argentina to World Cup final
articles.summary: Substitute Lautaro Martinez is in the right place at the right time to head home Lionel Messi's 92nd-minute cross to send Argentina to the World Cup final at the expense of England.

articles.title: Argentina celebrate progressing to World Cup final
articles.summary: Defending champions Argentina celebrate at full time, after beating England 2-1 to make it through to their second successive World Cup final.

articles.title: Final two World Cup matches to be shown live on BBC
articles.summary: Saturday's World Cup third-place play-off between England and France and Sunday's World Cup final will both be  live on BBC TV.

articles.title: Sunderland sign Belgium World Cup defender Meunier
articles.summary: Experienced Belgian defender Thomas Meunier signs for Sunderland after his contract with Lille comes to an end.

articles.title: 85, 90+2! Argentina's late show breaks England hearts to end World Cup dream
articles.summary: England missed out on their first World Cup final since 1966 after a stunning late turnaround from rivals Argentina saw the holders earn a 2-1 victory thanks to Lautaro Martinez's stoppage-time winner

articles.title: World Cup-winner Stiles' death linked to heading footballs, coroner rules
articles.summary: England 1966 World Cup winner Nobby Stiles died with a brain condition caused by repeatedly heading a football, a coroner has ruled.

articles.title: World Cup format changes revealed by ICC
articles.summary: The ICC has announced revamped structures for its two men's World Cup tournaments, including the creation of new 'Super Series' and 'Super 7' rounds at next year's 50-over tournament.
